name: DiSC #30
description:
Digital CD.v1 is all about relentless reinvention! It’s also an experiment on how to release a collection of music in Web3. Constructed using the Async Canvas Music Blueprint, Digital CD.v1 is a generative music collection of 100 Limited Edition NFTs — each provably random and unique.

5 tracks. 5 disc types. 3 disc conditions.
DiGiTAL x MAiWORLD. 2022.
